caption: The drawing depicts a square composition with a tan or light beige background bordered by a thin brown line. Inside, there is a red and dark maroon checkered vase lying on its side toward the bottom left corner, with green stems and leaves extending upward and outward. The stems support six stylized flowers: two are red with black dots and irregular petals, three are yellow with darker yellow accents and green dotted edges, and two are blue with darker blue wavy lines and a central red dot. All the flowers have green bases where they attach to the stems. Above the bouquet, there is a small line of decorative text in green. The entire image is framed by a cream colored border.
title: Pieced Autograph Quilt (1 Square)
